labels.note: Branch reached only when trailing-slash regex matched, so input is non-empty; fallback unreachable.
Needs both searches non-empty yet merging to empty query, e.g. '?&'; unrealistic input.
Query-only or hash-only inputs like '?a' or '#x' gain spurious leading '/'.
Literal '?' inside query is valid; '/foo/?a?b' becomes '/foo?ab', corrupting query.
'/foo?a?b' becomes '/foo/?ab'; valid query '?' characters silently dropped.
nextChar never ''; drops '?' check so withBase('/foo?x','/foo') duplicates base.
Only empty or '/' base with '//x' input differs; collapses slashes, arguably safer.
Same as disabling check: only '//x' inputs with empty base differ.
